.entry input {
                font-family: "Courier New","Liberation Mono",monospace;
                text-align: left;
                font-size: clamp(20px,3vw,30px);
                line-height: 1.1;
                letter-spacing: .03em;
                font-weight: 900;
                color: #fff8db;
                -webkit-text-fill-color: #fff8db;
                caret-color: #f6e5b7;
                text-shadow: 1px 1px #080908,0 0 4px #e6d8a653;
                padding: 8px 4px;
                background: transparent;
                width: 100%;
                min-width: 0
            }

            .entry input::placeholder {
                color: transparent
            }

            .panel-wood {
                margin: 25px -7px 0;
                padding: 11px 15px 17px;
                border: 10px solid #462817;
                border-top-color: #e0a76e;
                border-left-color: #ae7348;
                border-right-color: #452718;
                border-bottom-color: #26150e;
                background-image: var(--woodlit-tex);
                background-size: 192px 192px;
                box-shadow: inset 0 5px #d99a64,0 9px 0 #21130c
            }

            .controls {
                padding: 17px 24px;
                min-height: 138px;
                gap: 19px;
                border: 10px solid #41433d;
                border-top-color: #a9a69b;
                border-left-color: #8e8981;
                border-right-color: #292d29;
                border-bottom-color: #252923;
                background-image: var(--metal-tex);
                background-size: 192px 192px;
                box-shadow: inset 0 5px #908980,inset 0 -5px #272c27,7px 7px #1d1813
            }
